verdict.rationale: Flutterwave documents accepting payments in more than thirty currencies and offers an API to query FX rates and execute FX trades, which covers multi-currency charging and some FX visibility. Nothing documents automatic settlement to the merchant's bank in their home currency, or how conversion fees and rates are disclosed at settlement. Missing for 10: documented settlement-currency configuration to the merchant's bank, transparent FX fee and markup disclosure on conversions, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can charge customers in their local currencies and settle to my bank in mine with transparent FX handling
